verdict.rationale: No first-party docs describe a SharePoint automation feature. The only support is community reports of workflows built in SharePoint project sites and of flows that log form data and move files; these imply automations exist but do not show how they are configured or that they run autonomously in the background. Webhooks are a developer building block for an external app, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a SharePoint automation/workflow feature, evidence of autonomous background or scheduled execution, any AI or agentic automation, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: They create a site per project as a 'project-as-an-app' with constraints and workflows built with minimal effort.
One user built many flows that log form data into lists, track submissions and move files, and found it very useful.
